items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: Another question? Ms. Maya? Do you have another question to mind you'd like to ask?

ctx.x: Well, what about the clubs and auxiliaries? How do they work?

Well, the clubs, usually clubs, the social clubs, see. They give like banquet, dances for their finance, when there's, then too many members die, and the funds go lower in the treasury. Well, they give a couple of dances and things, see. And at the anniversary, every anniversary, they have a parade, you see. They're called the anniversary parade. See, that's the parade, you see them on the streets there. They're colored with all the baskets and things like that, see. They spend a lot of money for that stuff. You…
Well, are the auxiliaries part of the clubs or are they separate?
